question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Tidy
solution:
The correct answer is-'Orderly'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 

 
• The most appropriate synonym for** "tidy" **is **"orderly" (option 2).**
 
• **Tidy **means **neat and well-organized**, while **orderly **means** arranged or organized in a neat and tidy manner.**
 
• Both words convey the same sense of being well-kept and well-maintained.
 
• The other options and their meanings are:
 
• **Muddy **- covered or filled with mud, dirt or grime. This word is the opposite of "tidy".
 
 
• Example: The rain made the streets **muddy **and difficult to walk on.
 
 
 
• **Petty **- of little importance, trivial, insignificant.
 
 
• Example: She didn't want to argue about **petty **issues.
 
 
 
• **Nominal **- in name only, very small or insignificant.
 
 
• Example: He held a **nominal **position in the company.
 
 
 
• In conclusion, the word "**orderly**" is the most appropriate synonym for "**tidy**", as both words convey the same meaning of being well-organized and well-kept.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.**
